phases.name: audit-demo-team
phases.description: DF5.3 audit-chain demo: one dispatch_task turn on the proven T2 pair. The task is pure single-turn arithmetic Q&A so every micro of spend is token spend attributable by roster role; the multi-agent spawn variant overflowed every ceiling (SC2.7 rounds 6/10: >170s, >300s across real OpenRouter latency).
phases.task: Reply with only the number: 19*21. Then finish with a JSON object of shape {"changedFiles": [], "result": {"summary": "answer=<the number>"}}. Do not modify any files. Do not spawn any worker.

phases.name: audit-demo-commit
phases.description: Writes the demo artifact and commits it on the sandbox branch, so the run produces the commits harvest bundles into refs/sandbox/<run-id> — a run with no commits harvests NOCOMMITS and the run-bundle hop has no subject.
command:
set -eu; printf 'QDS-Factory audit-chain demo

Produced in-box by the phase engine at base %s.
Walk this PR with: bun scripts/qds-audit.ts <pr-url>
' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" > DEMO.md; git add DEMO.md; git -c user.email=factory@qds.local -c user.name='QDS Factory' commit -q -m 'demo: audit-chain walk artifact'; git log --oneline -1
